summary: Google is giving up to 10,000 selected scientists 6 months of free access to the highest usage tier in Google Antigravity, including Gemini 4 Argon, announced 2026-10-13 alongside the Gemini 4 Argon launch. The program is intended to support non-commercial scientific research by researchers with an active affiliation at a university, degree-granting institution, non-profit research institute, or national laboratory. Selection weighs scientific credentials and potential research impact; cohorts are onboarded weekly on a rolling basis as capacity allows, and only selected applicants are contacted. Access applies to the individual Antigravity service on the Google account used to apply. No application deadline is stated. The official interest form requires institutional email and a public research-group/lab URL, plus at least one valid ORCID iD or Google Scholar profile for an application to be considered. Submitted information must be accurate, non-confidential and non-proprietary. The affiliation email is for verification/communications and may be associated with only one Google Account; upgraded access goes to the account used to submit.
claim_steps: Check eligibility: non-commercial scientific research with an active affiliation at a university, degree-granting institution, non-profit research institute, or national laboratory.
Open the interest form from https://antigravity.google/use-cases/science (Apply here) and sign in with the Google account that should receive access (institutional Workspace or personal Gmail).

Prepare an institutional email, a public lab/research-group or qualifying directory/profile URL, and a valid ORCID iD or Google Scholar profile; applications without either research identifier are not considered.
Submit accurate, non-confidential and non-proprietary information. Google reviews weekly as capacity allows and contacts only selected applicants; submission does not guarantee selection.
If selected, the upgraded access applies to the individual Google Antigravity service on that account for 6 months.
